title: Extrair narrateReport() helper no loop.ts (dedup dos ~9 blocos inline de notifyOrchestrator)
description: Follow-up advisory do review do CAM-78 (PR da branch cam/CAM-78-sidecar-sole-pusher). O US-003 ligou a narração do sidecar em ~9 call-sites do src/supervisor/loop.ts, cada um repetindo o bloco `{ const r = readWorkerReport?.(); if (r) opts.notifyOrchestrator?.(formatWorkerReportSummary(r)); }`. O reviewer sugeriu (SUGGESTION, nao-gating) extrair um helper privado (ex: narrateReport()) para legibilidade e single-source. Bonus: encolhe loop.ts e reverte a subida de teto file-size aplicada no ship do CAM-78. Arquivo: src/supervisor/loop.ts.
